title: Signed export
description: The envelope every signed export answers: an approval's audit bundle (`POST /v1/approvals/{approvalId}/audit-bundle`), a run's provenance (`POST /v1/provenance/{runId}/export`) and compliance evidence (`POST /v1/compliance/evidence/export`). `bundle` is base64 of the exact bytes that were signed: the body, as sorted-key JSON with no whitespace. A verifier checks the Ed25519 `signature` over those bytes and re-serializes nothing. The embedded `publicKey` only proves the bytes weren't changed; pin the deployment's keys (`GET /v1/export-signing-keys`) to know who signed them. The body of an audit bundle is `audit-bundle.schema.json`.

kind.description: Which export this is. Absent from older servers.

bundle.description: Base64 of the signed bytes: the body, as sorted-key JSON.

bundleSchemaVersion.description: The body's version, semver: audit bundle 2.0.0, provenance 1.2.0, compliance 1.0.0.

algorithm.description: The signing key's algorithm. An `ecdsa-p256-sha256` signature is IEEE P1363 `r‖s`. A verifier refuses an algorithm it doesn't know, naming it.

signingKeyId.description: The key that signed it: one of `GET /v1/export-signing-keys`.

signature.description: Base64 of the 64-byte signature over the `bundle` bytes: Ed25519's, or ECDSA P-256's as IEEE P1363 `r‖s`.

publicKey.description: The signing key's public half, PEM SPKI.

exportedAt.description: When it was signed: the same instant as the signed body's `exportedAt`.
